=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, SOLDIERS,
ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME/VILLAGE,
and battle final-frame references.

Keep Riven and Ally Soldier exactly consistent with their references.

The battle final-frame defines the situation and character positions:
Riven and Ally are allies, standing together at the center of a large
circle of enemy SOLDIERS.

Keep this situation throughout the opening.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded realistic action.

Natural English dialogue.

Simple camera movement.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Begin with a SOLDIER passing close across the foreground.

As he clears the frame, reveal Riven and Ally much closer.

Riven and Ally are standing back-to-back at the CENTER
of the surrounding army.

A large circle of SOLDIERS surrounds BOTH of them.

Riven and Ally are allies.

They fight the surrounding SOLDIERS together.

They never fight each other.


Riven blocks a SOLDIER attacking from her side.

Ally blocks another SOLDIER attacking from the opposite side.

They stay close together and hold their position.


Then show one archer at the side of the surrounding army.

The archer aims at Riven.

He fires one arrow.


The arrow flies sideways across the battlefield toward Riven.

Riven is looking in another direction and does not see it.


Ally sees the arrow.

He shouts:

"RIVEN!"


Ally immediately throws himself in front of Riven.


The arrow hits Ally instead.


ONLY ALLY is hit.

ONLY ALLY falls.

Riven catches Ally as he collapses.

All other SOLDIERS remain standing in the background.


Stay close on Riven holding Ally.

Riven asks:

"Why?"


Ally weakly answers:

"You would've done the same."


Ally dies in Riven's arms.


Riven slowly looks into the distance.

Far across the valley,
dark smoke and orange fire rise from her home village.


Riven looks at the burning village.

Then she looks back down at Ally.


Riven slowly lowers Ally onto the ground.

CUT.
